# langsmith_filter_view (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a LangSmith filter view (saved filter) by project/session ID and view ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_filter_view" "example" {
  session_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  id         = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the filter view.
- `session_id` (String) The project/session ID the filter view belongs to.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) A description of the filter view.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the filter view.
- `duration` (String) The duration filter.
- `end_time` (String) The end time filter (ISO 8601).
- `filter_string` (String) The run filter expression.
- `start_time` (String) The start time filter (ISO 8601).
- `trace_filter_string` (String) The trace filter expression.
- `tree_filter_string` (String) The tree filter expression.
- `type` (String) The type of filter view (`runs` or `threads`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
